name: LockedIn
description: Solves LinkedIn's puzzle games (Queens, Tango, Mini Sudoku, Zip, Patches, Wend, CrossClimb) and overlays the solution on top of the page without touching the underlying DOM.

content_scripts.//: Matches all of linkedin.com, not just /games/*, and every game's detect() gates the rest. Chrome only injects a content script on a real document load, so a /games/* match meant that reaching a puzzle the normal way - clicking through from the feed, which LinkedIn routes client-side with no document load - left no script in the page at all. That's why Zip and Mini Sudoku only ever appeared after a hard refresh or a manual Solve (the popup force-injects). Matching every LinkedIn page means the script is already there when the SPA routes into a game, and the heartbeat in content.js notices the URL change.
